news.body_en: We have reached the semi-final stage in our search for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season, with four sensational strikes now competing to make it through to the grand final. As the field has narrowed, the quality of the goals has increased - no mean feat - making these selections the hardest yet. Michael Essien (2007) takes on Ramires (2012) in the first quarter-final, while Eden Hazard (2017) meets Moises Caicedo (2024) in the second. Who wins? You decide! You can watch both pairings below and then head to the Chelsea Official App to vote on which goals you think are better in the two polls. This will be fascinating! Michael Essien vs Arsenal - 2007 Essien’s strike against Arsenal edged out his own Barcelona effort by just a couple of per cent. With the Blues behind to Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball off to Michael around 30 yards out and the midfielder let rip with a glorious swerving strike that flew into the top corner. On an unforgettable night at the Nou Camp, Ramires’s strike brought us level in the tie and ahead on away goals, setting us on course to our first Champions League trophy. The Brazilian raced on to Frank Lampard’s exquisitely weighted pass and produced the most audacious of finishes as his first-time chip over Victor Valdes found the back of the net. Hazard's strike against Arsenal showcased everything Eden had to offer the Blues. Picking up possession inside his own half, the Belgian displayed strength to shrug off Francis Coquelin while retaining his balance to take on the Arsenal backline before calmly beating Petr Cech to register a sensational solo goal. Moises Caicedo vs Bournemouth - 2024 Few players can have got off the mark for us in such stupendous fashion as Moises Caicedo. Collecting a loose clearance just inside our own half, Caicedo smashed an inch-perfect effort over the desperately retreating defender and into the empty net from the halfway line. Return tomorrow (Sunday) to find out the goals that have advanced to final, which will be decided by votes cast on Monday!
news.body_zh: 我们已经进入半决赛，寻找切尔西本赛季的终极进球，四粒精彩进球正在争夺进入总决赛的机会。随着范围的缩小，进球的质量也随之提高——这绝非易事——使得这些选择变得最困难。迈克尔·埃辛（2007 年）在第一场四分之一决赛中对阵拉米雷斯（2012 年），而艾登·阿扎尔（2017 年）在第二场四分之一决赛中对阵莫伊塞斯·凯塞多（2024 年）。谁赢了？你决定！您可以观看下面的两对配对，然后前往切尔西官方应用程序，对您认为在这两个民意调查中哪些进球更好进行投票。这将是令人着迷的！迈克尔·埃辛 vs 阿森纳 - 2007 年埃辛对阵阿森纳的进球仅比他在巴塞罗那的进球高出几个百分点。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后阿森纳时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球传给了 30 码外的迈克尔，这名中场球员一脚漂亮的转身射门，飞入球门上角。在诺坎普度过了一个难忘的夜晚，拉米雷斯的进球让我们在平局中扳平比分，并以客场进球数领先，让我们朝着我们的第一座欧冠奖杯迈进。巴西人紧接着弗兰克·兰帕德（Frank Lampard）精妙的传球，并完成了最大胆的射门，他的第一次射门越过维克托·巴尔德斯（Victor Valdes）入网。阿扎尔对阵阿森纳的进球展示了伊甸园为蓝军提供的一切。比利时人在本方半场拿到控球权后，展现出了力量，摆脱了弗朗西斯·科奎林的防守，同时保持平衡，挑战了阿森纳的后防线，然后冷静地击败了切赫，打进了一粒轰动一时的个人进球。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 vs 伯恩茅斯 - 2024 很少有球员能像莫伊塞斯·凯塞多那样以如此惊人的方式为我们取得进球。凯塞多在本方半场内接到一次松散的解围，一脚完美的射门越过了拼命撤退的防守队员，从中线射入空门。明天（周日）回来看看晋级决赛的目标，周一投票决定！

news.title: Internationals: Lavia and Lacroix involved as England U21s qualify
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：拉维亚和拉克鲁瓦参与英格兰 U21 晋级
news.body_en: Both Romeo Lavia and Maxence Lacroix came off the bench in UEFA Nations League fixtures on Friday night, while Josh Acheampong started for England Under-21s as they booked their place at next summer's European Championships. Lavia, fresh from his first senior start on Sunday, was brought on an hour into Belgium's 3-0 victory at home to Turkey. By that point Kevin De Bruyne had netted twice and another former Chelsea player, Romelu Lukaku, added the third with a quarter-of-an-hour remaining. Mike Penders was an unused sub. In the same Nations League group, France were held to a 1-1 draw by Italy in Paris. Lacroix was introduced immediately after fellow centre-back Dayot Upamecano was shown a second yellow card with a few minutes of the game remaining, helping Les Bleus see out the point. Alessandro Bastoni had cancelled out Michael Olise's opener. France are top of Group 1 qualifying in League A with seven points, one more than Belgium. England Under-21s secured their spot at the 2027 Euros following a goalless draw with Slovakia in Stoke. Acheampong played the full 90 minutes and, in a game England dominated, had an arrowed drive well saved shortly before half-time. England will face Ireland in Cork in their final group fixture on Tuesday, before looking to defend their title next summer. At Under-19 level, Reggie Walsh and Chizarem Ezenwata started for England as they defeated the United States 2-1 in Spain. Both players were withdrawn in the second half, while goalkeeper Freddy Bernal was an unused sub as England extended their winning run to five games ahead of their final fixture of this window, against Belgium on Monday.
news.body_zh: 周五晚上，罗密欧·拉维亚和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦都在欧洲国家联赛中替补出场，而乔什·阿奇姆蓬则为英格兰 21 岁以下青年队首发，为他们预订了明年夏天欧洲锦标赛的席位。周日，拉维亚刚刚在成年队首次首发，在比利时主场 3-0 战胜土耳其的比赛中，他在比赛开始一个小时后就上场了。至此，凯文·德布劳内已经攻入两球，另一位前切尔西球员罗梅卢·卢卡库在比赛还剩一刻钟时攻入第三球。迈克·彭德斯是一名未使用的替补。国联小组赛中，法国队在巴黎1-1战平意大利队。在比赛还剩几分钟时，中后卫达约特·乌帕梅卡诺吃到第二张黄牌后，拉克鲁瓦立即被换上场，帮助高卢军团扳平比分。亚历山德罗·巴斯托尼（Alessandro Bastoni）取消了迈克尔·奥利斯（Michael Olise）的首开纪录。法国队在 A 联赛预选赛第一组中积 7 分，比比利时多 1 分，位居榜首。英格兰U-21队在斯托克与斯洛伐克队互交白卷，锁定了参加2027年欧洲杯的席位。阿奇姆蓬打满了 90 分钟，在这场英格兰占据主导地位的比赛中，他在半场结束前不久的一次射门被扑出。英格兰队将于周二在科克举行小组赛最后一场比赛，对阵爱尔兰队，然后寻求明年夏天卫冕冠军。在 19 岁以下级别比赛中，雷吉·沃尔什 (Reggie Walsh) 和奇扎雷姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizarem Ezenwata) 代表英格兰队在西班牙以 2-1 击败美国队。两名球员都在下半场退出，而门将弗雷迪·伯纳尔则没有上场，英格兰队在周一对阵比利时的本窗口最后一场比赛之前将连胜势头扩大到五场。

news.title: Book Premier League matches with Club Chelsea and meet a legend
news.title_zh: 预订切尔西俱乐部的英超比赛并会见传奇人物
news.body_en: There is a tantalising wait for Premier League football to return this month but when it does so with three home games in October, anyone taking advantage of selected Club Chelsea packages to watch the action will have a famous Blues name for company – Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink, Cesar Azpilicueta or Claude Makelele no less. A longer than usual break for international fixtures ends on Saturday 10 October when we host Bournemouth for a traditional 3pm kick-off, followed later in the month by back-to-back weekends at Stamford Bridge for the massive meetings with Tottenham and Manchester United. Those games are on Saturday 24 October at 5.30pm and Saturday 31 October at 12.30pm respectively. All three matches are available to book now with Club Chelsea’s award-winning hospitality. The following packages unlock access to each day’s legend: Dugout Club – as part of the package that is the pinnacle of sporting hospitality, you will meet the legend and receive an item signed by him. Clubhouse & Stamford Place – The Clubhouse is a brand-new addition to the portfolio while Stamford Place offers two distinct matchday experiences. Each comes with the chance to meet the legend. Under The Bridge – The electric pre-match atmosphere in this venue will be boosted further by an appearance from the legend. One of the deadliest marksmen to wear the Chelsea blue returns to the Bridge for our next outing. Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink will be Club Chelsea’s legend that day, no doubt recounting tales of some of those 87 goals scored, more often than not fired in with unstoppable power. As the player who won it all, Cesar Azpilicueta had his fair share of good days taking on Tottenham. As the sixth-highest appearance-maker in our history and winner of 11 cups, including being the captain who lifted one of our Champions League trophies, the iconic defender does not lack for stories to tell. It was with victory against Man U at the Bridge two decades ago that Claude Makelele became a back-to-back Premier League champion with Chelsea, and was universally acclaimed as a vital part of that hugely successful team. The French international midfielder came to define his influential role on the pitch and set the benchmark for those who followed. Now he is coming back to the stadium where he shone for what is always one of the glamour games of the season. The three-week pause on the Premier League season is coming to an end and you can join the legends at the Bridge this October. Click to explore the Club Chelsea packages on offer and secure your place
news.body_zh: 人们对英超联赛本月回归的等待令人着迷，但当它在十月举行三场主场比赛时，任何利用切尔西俱乐部精选套餐观看比赛的人都将有一个著名的蓝军名字陪伴——吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克、塞萨尔·阿兹皮利奎塔或克劳德·马克莱莱。比平常更长的国际比赛休息时间将于 10 月 10 日星期六结束，届时我们将在下午 3 点传统的主场迎战伯恩茅斯，随后在本月晚些时候在斯坦福桥连续两个周末与托特纳姆热刺队和曼联队进行大型比赛。这些比赛分别于 10 月 24 日星期六下午 5 点半和 10 月 31 日星期六中午 12 点半举行。所有三场比赛均可立即预订，享受切尔西俱乐部屡获殊荣的热情款待。以下套餐可解锁每天的传奇人物： Dugout Club – 作为体育接待巅峰套餐的一部分，您将见到这位传奇人物并收到他签名的物品。俱乐部会所和斯坦福广场 – 俱乐部会所是该组合的全新补充，而斯坦福广场则提供两种独特的比赛日体验。每个人都有机会见到传奇人物。桥下——这位传奇人物的登场将进一步提升赛场的紧张气氛。穿着切尔西蓝色球衣的最致命的神射手之一回到了蓝桥，参加我们的下一场比赛。吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克将成为那天切尔西俱乐部的传奇人物，毫无疑问，他将讲述 87 个进球中的一些进球的故事，这些进球往往具有不可阻挡的力量。作为赢得这一切的球员，塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔在对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中度过了美好的时光。作为我们历史上出场次数排名第六的球员和 11 座奖杯的获得者，包括作为队长举起我们的一座欧冠奖杯，这位标志性后卫并不缺乏故事可讲。二十年前，克劳德·马克莱莱在蓝桥战胜曼联，带领切尔西连续两年获得英超联赛冠军，并被普遍认为是这支取得巨大成功的球队的重要组成部分。这位法国国脚中场开始定义自己在球场上的影响力角色，并为后继者树立了标杆。现在他回到了球场，在那里他在本赛季最精彩的比赛之一中大放异彩。英超联赛为期三周的停赛即将结束，今年十月您可以与传奇人物一起前往蓝桥。点击探索切尔西俱乐部提供的套餐并确保您的席位

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-West Ham press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在西汉姆联赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash away at West Ham on Sunday afternoon, and here are the stand-out talking points from her press conference. The Blues make the short trip to Dagenham for the final game in a run of fixtures that began in late August with a two-legged Women's Champions League qualifier against Real Sociedad. Our players will then head off to represent their national teams before returning to face Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October. We are unbeaten since the start of the campaign, with six wins and two draws, and we have not conceded in our last five matches in all competitions. The head coach was asked about that defensive record and how she handles her half-time team talks alongside assistant coach Camille Abily... 'The West Ham game is as important as the Arsenal one, one week ago. It's three points. They have the team to be strong and compact out of possession, but also the individual players to help the team in transition. When they recover the ball, they have the speed up front and the technicality to help the team. 'That's the main way other teams can hurt us. From the beginning of the season, we have been the better team in terms of how we defend those moments in the game, and we will have to be strong again on Sunday against West Ham.' 'When we come into half-time, it's really important to keep being confident. Sometimes we follow the process because the things we are doing on the pitch are good enough and it's working, so it's just a case of reinforcing those messages. 'We always find the balance between talking about the tactical aspects, but also the confidence we need to have going into the second half and the mindset. Sometimes I am the one who is talking about the tactical aspects, and Camille is talking more about the mindset. Sometimes we do it the opposite way around. 'I always allow the players to talk at half-time to express how they feel and how they felt during the first half. We have enough experience in this group to know exactly what to say, what to do, how to do things at half-time depending on how we perform in the first half.' 'We have improved a lot as a team. Being together is a key element of our success, as well as players having clarity on their role on the pitch. When you play in the backline, when you play in the midfield, every position on the pitch, it helps a lot for them to be doing things at 100 per cent. 'I need to continue to provide clarity on how they need to defend depending on the situations. The mentality and the mindset not to want to concede anything is as important as the tactical aspects.' 'This block has been intense, and I'm pretty pleased with the results we got. Every player in the team is performing at her best and bringing her best every day in training and for the games. I'm pleased with where we are right now. We still have one game to go, so it's really important for us to keep that momentum. 'It's also good for everyone to get a break because it gives the players a chance to change their environment, see different people, go back to their countries and, for some of them, speak their language. It's really beneficial for them. 'For the ones who are staying here, it will be good to have some rest, and we'll keep working hard to make sure the players who are staying are in a good place when we come back and start again. I see these breaks as a positive thing for everyone.' 'In those moments, it's important for Aggie to keep working hard. There are not a lot of things she can control in this situation, so she needs to keep being confident, working hard on the pitch in training sessions, and we are here to support her in many ways. 'We already have a clear plan for her during the international break to help her to get back to a place where she will be more successful with us and with England as well. That's our job to keep working hard with her and give her the chance to return with England as soon as possible.'
news.body_zh: 周日下午我们客场对阵西汉姆联的女足超级联赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是她在新闻发布会上的重要谈话要点。蓝军短暂前往达格纳姆参加八月下旬开始的一系列比赛的最后一场比赛，与皇家社会队进行两回合的女子冠军联赛预选赛。然后，我们的球员将代表各自的国家队出发，然后于 10 月 18 日返回斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺队。自赛季开始以来，我们取得了六胜两平的不败战绩，并且在过去的五场比赛中我们没有丢球。主教练被问及防守记录，以及她如何与助理教练卡米尔·阿比利一起处理中场休息时的球队谈话……“一周前，西汉姆联队的比赛和阿森纳队的比赛一样重要。就是三点。他们有强大而紧凑的控球能力的球队，也有帮助球队转型的球员个人。当他们夺回球权时，他们拥有前场的速度和技术来帮助球队。 “这是其他球队伤害我们的主要方式。从赛季一开始，我们在比赛中防守这些时刻的方式上就一直是一支更好的球队，周日对阵西汉姆联的比赛中我们必须再次保持强势。” “当我们进入中场休息时，保持自信非常重要。有时我们遵循这个流程是因为我们在球场上所做的事情足够好而且正在发挥作用，所以这只是强化这些信息的一个例子。 “我们总是在谈论战术方面、以及进入下半场所需的信心和心态之间找到平衡。有时候我是在谈论战术方面，而卡米尔更多的是在谈论心态。有时我们会采取相反的做法。 “我总是允许球员在中场休息时发言，表达他们的感受以及上半场的感受。我们在这个小组中有足够的经验，能够准确地知道在中场休息时该说什么、该做什么、如何做，这取决于我们上半场的表现。” “作为一个团队，我们进步了很多。团结一致是我们成功的关键因素，球员们也清楚自己在球场上的角色。当你在后防线踢球时，当你在中场踢球时，球场上的每个位置上，他们百分百投入工作对他们有很大帮助。 “我需要继续澄清他们需要根据情况如何防守。不想让步的心态和心态与战术方面同样重要。” “这个区块非常激烈，我对我们得到的结果非常满意。球队中的每一位球员都在每天的训练和比赛中发挥出最佳水平。我对我们现在的处境感到满意。我们还有一场比赛要打，所以保持这种势头对我们来说非常重要。 “这对每个人来说都有好处，因为它让球员有机会改变他们的环境，见识不同的人，回到他们的国家，对他们中的一些人来说，还可以说他们的语言。这对他们来说确实是有好处的。 “对于留在这里的球员来说，休息一下是件好事，我们将继续努力，确保留在这里的球员在我们回来重新开始时处于良好的状态。我认为这些休息对每个人来说都是一件积极的事情。 “在那些时刻，对阿吉来说继续努力很重要。在这种情况下，她能控制的事情并不多，所以她需要保持自信，在训练场上努力训练，我们会在很多方面支持她。 “我们已经为她在国际比赛日期间制定了一个明确的计划，以帮助她回到一个能让她在我们和英格兰队中取得更大成功的地方。我们的工作就是继续和她一起努力，让她有机会尽快回到英格兰。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor and Blues defender nominated for WSL awards
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 和蓝军后卫获得 WSL 奖项提名
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has been nominated for the Women's Super League Manager of the Month award for September, while Lucy Bronze is up for the WSL Player of the Month award for her strong performances in the backline. Bompastor has steered us to three wins and a draw in our opening four WSL matches this season, including a perfectly-executed victory against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge last Sunday. We have conceded just once in those four matches, a late equaliser against Aston Villa on the opening day of the domestic campaign, and there was also a 5-0 win away at Manchester United on 13 September. Meanwhile Bronze has featured in all four of our WSL matches so far this season, scoring in stoppage time against Man United and contributing to our superb defensive record with some typically determined performances at centre-back. Voting for Manager of the Month and Player of the Month is now open and will close at 11am on Monday 5 October. The winner will be announced on Thursday 8 October. You can cast your vote for Sonia Bompastor by clicking here and for Lucy Bronze by clicking here.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 被提名为 9 月份女超联赛月度最佳主教练，而露西·青铜 (Lucy Bronze) 则凭借在后防线的出色表现，获得 WSL 月度最佳球员奖。邦帕斯托带领我们在本赛季的前四场 WSL 比赛中取得了三胜一平的成绩，其中包括上周日在斯坦福桥完美战胜阿森纳的比赛。在这四场比赛中我们只丢了一次球，国内联赛首日对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛最后时刻扳平比分，9月13日客场5-0战胜曼联。与此同时，布朗泽在本赛季迄今为止的所有四场 WSL 比赛中都有出场，在对阵曼联的补时阶段进球，并以中后卫的一些典型的坚定表现为我们出色的防守记录做出了贡献。本月最佳经理和本月最佳球员的投票现已开放，将于 10 月 5 日星期一上午 11 点结束。获胜者将于 10 月 8 日星期四公布。您可以点击此处为 Sonia Bompastor 投票，点击此处为 Lucy Bronze 投票。

news.title: Bompastor considers team selection against West Ham
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯特考虑对阵西汉姆联的球队选择
news.body_en: Our final fixture before the international break takes us across London to play West Ham United in the WSL, and Sonia Bompastor has explained how she will decide her team for Sunday’s derby. We travel east looking to build on our excellent start to the season. Bompastor’s side have won three and drawn one of our opening four league games, while in the Champions League our hard-earned point at Lyon midweek followed a tight 1-0 success against Austria Vienna. With the West Ham game coming hot off the heels of our trip to France, which in turn succeeded Sunday’s victory against Arsenal, Bompastor was asked at her media conference at Cobham if she would be rotating her side this weekend. ‘This club is so used to playing every three days,’ the head coach pointed out. ‘We build a squad for that reason. ‘It’s good to have the opportunity to rotate when we feel it’s appropriate. We will see what we do on Sunday, but the West Ham game is as important as the Arsenal one a week ago. It’s three points. ‘When you are getting good results, it helps a lot in terms of the recovery, the physical aspects but mainly the mental aspects, the confidence. It gives you a boost to be ready for the next one. ‘We are in a good place, and we have one more to go before the international break and that’s important for us.’

news.title: Before Rent Paid: The Nungua streets where King Promise learned to dream in blue
news.title_zh: 付房租之前：King Promise 学会在蓝色梦想中的 Nungua 街道
news.body_en: Watch a mini-documentary that traces King Promise's journey from a football-obsessed kid in Nungua to standing pitchside with Chelsea... Long before there was a Rent Paid movement, a King Promise discography, or a partnership with one of the world's biggest football clubs, there was a boy in Nungua who wanted exactly one thing: to be a footballer. That's where the mini-documentary begins: not backstage, not in a studio, but on the same dusty park where King Promise spent his childhood chasing a ball rather than a melody. The documentary team returns to the SDA Basic School grounds in Nungua, to the exact park where King Promise played as a boy. It's a small, unremarkable stretch of ground by most standards, but it's where a football-obsessed kid first learned the game he now brings sold-out crowds to, at exhibition matches with his own name on the poster. There's something quietly powerful about a global artist walking back onto that same patch of earth. It's not staged nostalgia. It's the plainest possible reminder that before any of this - the music, the movement, the partnership with Chelsea - there was just a boy who loved football more than almost anything else. No one tells that story better than the people who lived it alongside him. His auntie sat down with the documentary crew to talk about the boy she watched grow up. Not the artist, the boy. She speaks about who he was before the fame, and about something that hasn't changed since: he still comes home. Despite everything he's achieved as a musician, he checks in on family, and on the children in the neighbourhood who are growing up the way he once did. It's a detail that reframes everything the Rent Paid movement stands for. The commitment to the Nungua Orphanage isn't a campaign add-on; it's an extension of a habit he never broke. Neighbours who grew up alongside him add their own memories to the picture: the kid they remember from the block, long before the world knew his name. Their stories don't try to explain his success. They just place him firmly back where he started, as one of them. The documentary's emotional turn comes when King Promise talks football, specifically, Chelsea football. He traces his love for the club back to watching Michael Essien play, a Ghanaian icon whose success at Stamford Bridge made supporting Chelsea feel personal rather than incidental. For a generation of Ghanaian fans, Essien wasn't just a great player; he was proof that where you were from didn't limit where you could play. That's the seed the documentary follows all the way to the present day: a boy who wanted to be a footballer, who fell for Chelsea through a Ghanaian hero wearing the shirt, growing up to become a musician, and then, improbably, finding his way back to that same shirt through a partnership few could have scripted. The documentary frames the Chelsea partnership and the Rent Paid Football Exhibition Tournament as fate catching up with a childhood dream. King Promise didn't become the footballer he once wanted to be. Still, through Rent Paid, he's built something arguably harder to plan for: a genuine partnership with the exact club he grew up idolising, and a stage on which to actually play and wear the badge. It would have been easy to let the music video carry the whole story. Instead, the mini-documentary exists to answer the question the video doesn't: not what King Promise built, but why. Nungua made him. Football shaped him before music did. And the community he grew up in is the same one Rent Paid continues to give back to, activation after activation. Listen to King Promise's new Chelsea-themed song! By the time viewers reach the final frame, King Promise is back at McDan Park, in Chelsea blue, having built the very kind of moment his younger self in Nungua could only have imagined; the connection between the boy on that old park and the man behind Rent Paid isn't explained. It's simply, finally, visible.
news.body_zh: 观看一部迷你纪录片，讲述 King Promise 从一个 Nungua 痴迷足球的孩子到站在切尔西球场边的历程……早在“租金支付”运动、King Promise 唱片或与世界上最大的足球俱乐部之一合作之前，Nungua 有一个男孩只想要一件事：成为一名足球运动员。这就是这部迷你纪录片的开始：不是在后台，不是在工作室，而是在同一个布满灰尘的公园里，King Promise 在那里度过了他的童年，追逐一个球而不是一段旋律。纪录片团队返回农瓜 (Nungua) 的 SDA 基础学校操场，也就是 King Promise 小时候玩耍的公园。从大多数标准来看，这是一块不起眼的小场地，但这是一个痴迷于足球的孩子第一次学习这项运动的地方，他现在在海报上印有他自己名字的表演赛上吸引了满座的观众。一位全球艺术家重返同一片地球，有一种悄然强大的力量。这不是上演的怀旧。这是最简单的提醒：在这一切之前——音乐、运动、与切尔西的合作——只有一个男孩比其他任何事情都更热爱足球。没有人比和他一起生活的人更能讲述这个故事。他的阿姨与纪录片摄制组坐下来谈论她看着长大的男孩。不是艺术家，是男孩。她谈到了他在成名之前是谁，以及自那以后一直没有改变的事情：他仍然回家。尽管他作为一名音乐家取得了一切成就，但他还是会关心家人，以及邻居的孩子们，他们正像以前一样成长。这个细节重新定义了租金支付运动所代表的一切。对农瓜孤儿院的承诺并不是竞选活动的附加内容；而是一项活动。这是他从未打破的习惯的延伸。与他一起长大的邻居们将自己的记忆添加到了照片中：他们记得这个来自街区的孩子，早在全世界知道他的名字之前。他们的故事并没有试图解释他的成功。他们只是让他坚定地回到他开始的地方，作为他们中的一员。当 King Promise 谈论足球，特别是切尔西足球时，这部纪录片的情绪发生了转变。他对俱乐部的热爱可以追溯到观看加纳偶像迈克尔·埃辛的比赛，他在斯坦福桥的成功让支持切尔西变得个人化而不是偶然。对于一代加纳球迷来说，埃辛不仅是一位伟大的球员，而且是一位伟大的球员。他证明了你来自哪里并不限制你可以在哪里打球。这就是这部纪录片一直延续到今天的种子：一个想成为一名足球运动员的男孩，因为一位穿着这件球衣的加纳英雄而爱上了切尔西，长大后成为一名音乐家，然后，不可思议的是，他通过一种很少有人能脚本化的合作伙伴关系找到了回到那件球衣的道路。这部纪录片将切尔西的合作伙伴关系和租金支付足球表演赛描绘成命运追上了儿时的梦想。 King Promise 并没有成为他曾经想成为的足球运动员。尽管如此，通过“租付”，他还是建立了一些可以说更难计划的东西：与他从小就崇拜的俱乐部建立真正的合作伙伴关系，以及一个可以实际比赛并佩戴徽章的舞台。让音乐视频承载整个故事本来是很容易的。相反，这部迷你纪录片的存在是为了回答视频没有回答的问题：不是 King Promise 建造了什么，而是为什么。努瓜创造了他。足球先于音乐塑造了他。他成长的社区也是《Rent Paid》持续回馈的那个社区，一个又一个的激活。聆听 King Promise 的新切尔西主题歌曲！当观众到达最后一帧时，King Promise 回到了麦克丹公园，身着切尔西蓝，在努瓜创造了他年轻时只能想象的时刻；那个旧公园里的男孩和租金支付背后的人之间的联系没有得到解释。它最终是可见的。

news.body_en: The quarter-finals of our Ultimate Goal of the Season competition have concluded and we can reveal which four strikes have advanced to the next round. You cast your votes on the Chelsea Official App and in three of the four ties it was very close indeed. That was no more evident that in the all-Michael Essien quarter-final, with his swerving strike against Arsenal (51 per cent) edging out that spectacular volley against Barcelona (49 per cent). Essien's Arsenal goal will come up against Ramires' glorious chip in the Nou Camp in the semi-finals, with the Brazilian's effort receiving 58 per cent of the vote to beat Eden Hazard's Tottenham classic. It was Hazard's solo strike against Arsenal (70 per cent) that comfortably won over his individual effort at Anfield, while in the other quarter-final Moises Caicedo's halfway line strike got the better of his Blues team-mate Joao Pedro, the most recent entry in this competition. That means it's Hazard vs Caicedo in the other semi-final, with the poll opening tomorrow (Saturday) - be sure to return and have your say as we get ever closer to finding our Ultimate Chelsea Goal of the Season!

news.title_zh: 西汉姆联 vs 切尔西女足：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: Chelsea Women head to West Ham United on Sunday afternoon as we look to make it four consecutive wins in the Women's Super League. After getting the better of Arsenal at Stamford Bridge last weekend and securing a well-earned draw at Lyon in the Champions League, Sonia Bompastor's side face another London derby, this time away from home. Here are the key details for Sunday's meeting with the Hammers, including when we kick off and how you can follow the game. We face West Ham United on Sunday 4 October 2026 at the Chigwell Construction Stadium in Dagenham. Kick-off is at 2pm UK time. Supporters watching in the UK can catch the match live on Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Premier League, with coverage beginning at 1.30pm. Live streaming is also available through Sky Go for eligible subscribers and NOW with an appropriate membership. You can also follow our West Ham United vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website for team news and live minute-by-minute updates throughout the afternoon. Keep an eye on Chelsea Women's accounts on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok for more coverage around the match. Chelsea have collected 10 points from our opening four WSL fixtures, winning three and drawing one. We head into the weekend third in the table, having scored nine and conceded just once in the league so far. Since drawing with Aston Villa on the opening day, the Blues have beaten Manchester United 5-0, Birmingham City 2-0 and Arsenal 1-0. That gives us five successive clean sheets in all competitions as we prepare for our second WSL away trip of the campaign. West Ham's most recent league outing ended in a 2-1 defeat at Manchester United, but they responded with a 3-1 victory over Southampton in the Subway Players Cup on Wednesday. Oona Siren scored twice and Leila Wandeler was also on target as the Hammers came from behind. The Blues won both league meetings with West Ham last season, scoring nine goals without reply. Our trip to Dagenham in September 2025 ended in a 4-0 victory, with Aggie Beever-Jones' free-kick subsequently voted Chelsea's Goal of the Month. We then began 2026 with a 5-0 win over the Hammers at Kingsmeadow. An early Yu Endo own goal set us on our way, before Lauren James and Alyssa Thompson extended the advantage. Sandy Baltimore added two more, including a second-half penalty, to complete the scoring.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足将于周日下午前往西汉姆联，我们希望在女足超级联赛中实现四连胜。继上周末在斯坦福桥击败阿森纳并在冠军联赛中客场战平里昂之后，索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队将迎来另一场伦敦德比，这次是客场。以下是周日与铁锤队的会议的关键细节，包括我们何时开始以及您如何关注比赛。我们将于 2026 年 10 月 4 日星期日在达格纳姆的奇格韦尔建筑体育场迎战西汉姆联队。英国时间下午 2 点开始。在英国观看比赛的球迷可以在天空体育主赛事和天空体育超级联赛上观看比赛直播，直播时间为下午 1 点 30 分。符合条件的订阅者还可以通过 Sky Go 进行直播，并且拥有适当的会员资格也可以通过 NOW 进行直播。您还可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上关注我们的西汉姆联队对阵切尔西女子比赛中心，了解球队新闻和整个下午的实时更新。请密切关注切尔西女足在 X、Facebook、Instagram 和 TikTok 上的账户，了解有关比赛的更多报道。切尔西在 WSL 的前四场比赛中取得了 3 胜 1 平的成绩，积 10 分。我们进入周末积分榜第三位，到目前为止，我们在联赛中已经进了九球，只丢了一次球。自揭幕战战平阿斯顿维拉以来，蓝军已5-0击败曼联、2-0击败伯明翰城、1-0击败阿森纳。这让我们在所有比赛中连续五场不失球，为本赛季第二次 WSL 客场之旅做准备。西汉姆联最近一场联赛以 2-1 负于曼联，但在周三的赛百味球员杯比赛中以 3-1 战胜南安普顿队。乌纳·塞伦梅开二度，莱拉·万德勒也进球，铁锤队后来居上。上赛季，蓝军在与西汉姆联队的两次联赛交锋中都取得了胜利，打入九个进球，没有回复。 2025 年 9 月，我们前往达格纳姆的比赛以 4-0 的胜利结束，阿吉·比弗-琼斯的任意球随后被评选为切尔西本月最佳进球。随后，我们在 Kingsmeadow 5-0 战胜 Hammers 队，开启了 2026 年的征程。在劳伦·詹姆斯和阿丽莎·汤普森扩大优势之前，远藤佑早先的乌龙球让我们上路。桑迪·巴尔的摩再进两球，包括下半场的点球，完成得分。

news.title: Reggie Watson wins Premier League 2 Player of the Month
news.title_zh: 雷吉·沃森荣获英超二月最佳球员
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen midfielder Reggie Watson has been named Premier League 2 Player of the Month for September following some stellar performances for Harry Hudson’s side. Watson has enjoyed an impressive start to the 2026/27 season, scoring in each of our opening four PL2 matches. In September, the 16-year-old netted three goals in two games. Against Arsenal, Watson led by example, bagging a brace to help CNG on their way to a 4-1 victory. He converted his penalty in assured fashion, drilling the ball into the bottom left corner to double the Blues’ lead minutes before the interval. In the second half of that match, Watson made it 3-0 with a rifling free-kick into the far corner, striking the post on the way in. Before the international break, Watson played a key role against Fulham. The Blues came out 3-1 victors against the Cottagers, coming back from 1-0 down. Watson put CNG ahead for the first time shortly after the break, dispatching an ambitious shot from distance into the back of the net.
news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代中场球员雷吉·沃森在为哈里·哈德森的球队表现出色后被评为 9 月英超 2 月最佳球员。沃森在 2026/27 赛季取得了令人印象深刻的开局，在我们的前四场 PL2 比赛中每一场都有进球。 9月份，这位16岁的球员在两场比赛中攻入了三个进球。在对阵阿森纳的比赛中，沃森以身作则，梅开二度帮助CNG以4-1获胜。他以一种自信的方式罚进了点球，将球打入左下角，在中场休息前几分钟将蓝军的领先优势扩大了一倍。在那场比赛的下半场，沃森将一脚任意球打入远角，击中立柱，将比分改写为3-0。国际比赛日之前，沃森在对阵富勒姆的比赛中发挥了关键作用。蓝军在0-1落后的情况下，以3-1战胜了农民队。中场休息后不久，沃森一脚雄心勃勃的远射入网，让 CNG 首次取得领先。

news.title: Valentin Barco: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 瓦伦丁·巴科：我的足球第一次
news.body_en: Valentin Barco is the next Chelsea player to tell us about his earliest experiences of the game, with our summer signing growing up in a football-mad country. Barco is currently away representing Argentina during this prolonged international break, which followed his full Premier League debut in our fixture at Brentford. Before he departed, we caught up with Valentin to find out some of his firsts in football… What was the first football match you went to? It would have been a Boca Juniors game at La Bombonera in Buenos Aires, but I honestly can’t remember which! What were your first football boots? I don’t know who made them but I remember the colour, they were definitely black. What was the first kit you owned? What’s the first piece of advice you remember? Just to look forward and to work hard every day. Who was your first friend in football? Agustin Giay. He plays for Palmeiras in Brazil now. Who was the first team-mate you roomed with? Agustin too, when we played for Argentina youth teams together. Who was your first team debut against? It was for Boca in an away game against Union Santa Fe. We drew 1-1. I was 16 years old. Who was the first goal you scored against? It was against Monagas from Venezuela in the Copa Libertadores. It was a nice goal actually! Your first emotion after signing for Chelsea… Such a big, huge emotion. A proud feeling.
news.body_zh: 瓦伦丁·巴科（Valentin Barco）是下一位向我们讲述他最早的足球经历的切尔西球员，我们的夏季签约球员是在一个足球狂热的国家长大的。巴科目前在这场漫长的国际比赛期间代表阿根廷队出战，此前他在布伦特福德的比赛中完成了英超首秀。在他离开之前，我们采访了瓦伦丁，了解了他在足球领域的一些第一次……您去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？这本来是在布宜诺斯艾利斯的糖果盒球场举行的博卡青年队比赛，但老实说我不记得是哪一场了！您的第一双足球鞋是什么？我不知道是谁制造的，但我记得颜色，它们肯定是黑色的。您拥有的第一个套件是什么？您记得的第一条建议是什么？只为期待并努力工作每一天。你在足球界的第一个朋友是谁？奥古斯丁·吉亚.他现在效力于巴西的帕尔梅拉斯队。你第一个同住的队友是谁？奥古斯丁也是，当我们一起为阿根廷青年队效力时。你的第一支球队首秀对阵谁？这是博卡在客场对阵圣达菲联盟的比赛中的表现。我们1-1战平。那年我16岁。你第一个进球的对手是谁？解放者杯对阵委内瑞拉的莫纳加斯。这实际上是一个不错的目标！你与切尔西签约后的第一个感受……如此强烈、巨大的感受。一种自豪的感觉。

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Manchester United at home - update to ticket application window
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：曼联主场 - 门票申请窗口更新
news.body_en: The ticket selling information has been updated for our final fixture of this month. Chelsea host Manchester United in a Premier League encounter on Saturday 31 October with a 12:30pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge. Members who applied successfully or unsuccessfully will start to be notified of the outcome the week commencing Monday 5 October. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: Loyalty points accrued so far this season will be applied to this fixture. To be successful in this ticket application window, fans will be required to have 9 loyalty points or more. Only supporters who are eligible will show to be selectable in the application process. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this page. Ticket application window opens – Monday 21 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 21 September 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 1 October. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The sales information on the buy tickets pagewill be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window, who met the loyalty points criteria for this fixture, will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. news.title: Internationals: Neto's Portugal put four past Denmark
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：内托带领的葡萄牙队四胜丹麦队
news.body_en: Pedro Neto featured for Portugal as they maintained their 100 per cent record in the UEFA Nations League with a 4-2 victory over Denmark, while Jorrel Hato's Netherlands were also in action. Pedro Neto was a constant threat down the right flank, creating four chances in Copenhagen, with goals from Joao Cancelo, Goncalo Ramos, Vitinha and Joao Felix securing a memorable win despite two strikes from the hosts. Neto was replaced by former Blue Joao Felix in the 81st minute, with the forward going on to score Portugal's fourth and final goal. Portugal have one final game to come in the extended international break when they face Norway on Sunday 4 October, with kick-off set for 7.45pm (UK time). Elsewhere in the competition, Hato's Netherlands earned a late point in Greece after going two goals down, drawing 2-2 in Thessaloniki. The full-back remained an unused substitute as Tijjani Reijnders salvaged a draw in Group 2 of League A with an 89th-minute equaliser. Jorrel could be in action on Sunday when the Netherlands host Serbia (7.45pm KO UK) in their final game of the current international period. Finally, Reggie Watson played 68 mins, Heze Grimwade played 57 mins, and Josh Henry came on as a sub in England Under-17s' 1-0 win over Venezuela during their three-game mini-tournament in Germany. They have one final test to come against hosts Germany on Sunday morning (11am).
news.body_zh: 佩德罗·内托代表葡萄牙队在欧洲国家联赛中以 4-2 战胜丹麦，保持着 100% 的战绩，而乔雷尔·哈托 (Jorrel Hato) 的荷兰队也在比赛中。佩德罗·内托在右翼不断构成威胁，在哥本哈根创造了四次机会，尽管主队两次进球，但若昂·坎塞洛、贡卡洛·拉莫斯、维蒂尼亚和若昂·菲利克斯的进球帮助球队取得了令人难忘的胜利。第81分钟，内托被前蓝军若昂·菲利克斯换下，这位前锋打进了葡萄牙的第四个也是最后一个进球。葡萄牙队在延长的国际比赛日中还有最后一场比赛，他们将于 10 月 4 日星期日对阵挪威，开球时间为晚上 7 点 45 分（英国时间）。在其他比赛中，哈托率领的荷兰队在落后两球的情况下在希腊比赛中以2-2战平塞萨洛尼基，最终赢得一分。这位边后卫仍然没有上场，替补出场，蒂贾尼·雷德尔斯在甲级联赛第 89 分钟扳平比分，挽救了一场平局。乔雷尔可能会在周日的国际比赛最后一场比赛中上场，届时荷兰队将主场迎战塞尔维亚队（晚上 7 点 45 分，KO 英国队）。最后，在德国举行的三场迷你锦标赛中，英格兰U-17队1-0战胜委内瑞拉队，雷吉·沃森打了68分钟，黑泽·格里姆韦德打了57分钟，约什·亨利替补上场。他们将在周日上午（上午 11 点）对阵东道主德国队进行最后一场测试。

news.title: Can't Tame Us: How King Promise and Chelsea turned a football tournament into a music video
news.title_zh: 无法驯服我们：King Promise 和切尔西如何将足球锦标赛变成音乐录影带
news.body_en: The compelling story of how the music video for 'Can't Tame Us (Chelsea Anthem)' by King Promise was made... The track itself is a love letter, written by one of Chelsea's own to the club's supporters across Africa. It made its debut at a matchday, will feature at fixtures throughout the season, and was officially released on 12 September, as part of our 'London to the World' approach to culture, celebrating the communities that make up the club's global family. Most music videos are built around a concept, then a location is found to fit it. This one worked the other way round. The tournament King Promise built himself, and the park in Nungua he's known since he was a boy, came first; the video, directed by Derrick Arthur, was shaped to live inside both. It was filmed across two real locations: the Rent Paid Football Exhibition Tournament, where King Promise and Chelsea brought the club's new home kit to Africa for the first time, and Nungua SDA Park, the ground where King Promise grew up playing football. The tournament footage carries the scale and the occasion: a football pitch packed with fans, King Promise alongside Chelsea Supporter Clubs from across Ghana, including Team DWP, Team New Media and Amen X Eleven, and our own home kit launch happening in real time. The Nungua SDA Park sequence carries something quieter: King Promise performing the track on home ground, no crowd built for the camera, just the artist and the place that shaped him. Cutting between the two isn't a stylistic flourish. It's the structure of the story itself: where King Promise is now, and where he started. 'Returning to Nungua SDA Park was very important to me because that is where it all started for me. My love for football, spending time playing with my friends and connecting with community through football games was very special to me,' says King Promise. The tournament marked something bigger than a single music video: the first appearance of our new home kit on African soil, and a gathering of Blues supporter clubs from across Ghana. Rather than treat that as a separate marketing moment, the video builds it directly into the story: the kit reveal, the Chelsea crest against the Rent Paid backdrop, and King Promise wearing the shirt on the pitch, all captured as it happened. 'King Promise came to us with the idea for the track and, knowing how much Chelsea means to him, it felt like a really natural collaboration,' says Scott Fenton, brand director at Chelsea Football Club. 'This is about celebrating our fans in Africa and the culture around the club, and showing what Chelsea can mean beyond the 90 minutes. Music is such a powerful way to bring people together, and this is a brilliant example of that.' For King Promise, the collaboration isn't a brand tie-in bolted onto a song; it's the continuation of a lifelong relationship with the club, one that runs through his childhood in Nungua and idols like Michael Essien. That part of the story gets its own telling elsewhere; here, it shows up simply as a musician wearing the shirt he's loved since he was a boy, on the day it mattered most.
news.body_zh: 讲述 King Promise 的《Can't Tame Us（切尔西国歌）》音乐录影带的制作过程的引人入胜的故事……这首歌本身就是一封情书，由切尔西的一位员工写给俱乐部在非洲各地的支持者。它在比赛日首次亮相，并将在整个赛季的比赛中亮相，并于 9 月 12 日正式发布，作为我们“伦敦走向世界”文化的一部分，庆祝构成俱乐部全球大家庭的社区。大多数音乐视频都是围绕一个概念构建的，然后找到适合它的位置。这个则相反。 King Promise 自己建造的锦标赛以及他从小就知道的 Nungua 公园是第一位的；该视频由德里克·阿瑟 (Derrick Arthur) 执导，旨在融入两者之中。该片在两个真实地点拍摄：租金支付足球表演赛，King Promise 和切尔西首次将俱乐部的新主场球衣带到非洲；以及 Nungua SDA Park，King Promise 从小踢足球的地方。比赛镜头体现了规模和场合：挤满球迷的足球场、King Promise 以及来自加纳各地的切尔西支持者俱乐部，包括 Team DWP、Team New Media 和 Amen X Eleven，以及我们自己的主场球衣实时发布。 Nungua SDA 公园的场景有些安静：King Promise 在主场表演这首歌，没有为镜头聚集的人群，只有艺术家和塑造他的地方。两者之间的切换并不是一种风格上的华丽。这是故事本身的结构：国王承诺现在在哪里，以及他开始的地方。 “回到 Nungua SDA 公园对我来说非常重要，因为那是我一切的起点。我对足球的热爱、花时间与朋友一起踢球以及通过足球比赛与社区建立联系对我来说非常特别，”King Promise 说道。这场比赛标志着比单一音乐视频更重要的事情：我们的新主场球衣首次在非洲土地上亮相，以及来自加纳各地的蓝调支持者俱乐部的聚会。该视频并没有将其视为一个单独的营销时刻，而是直接将其融入到故事中：球衣展示、在“已付租金”背景下的切尔西队徽以及国王诺言在球场上穿着这件球衣，所有这些都在发生时被捕捉到。切尔西足球俱乐部品牌总监斯科特·芬顿 (Scott Fenton) 表示：“King Promise 向我们提出了这条赛道的想法，并且知道切尔西对他来说意味着什么，这感觉就像一次非常自然的合作。” “这是为了庆祝我们在非洲的球迷和俱乐部的文化，并展示切尔西在 90 分钟之后的意义。音乐是将人们聚集在一起的强大方式，这就是一个很好的例子。”对于 King Promise 来说，这次合作并不是将品牌与歌曲捆绑在一起；而是将品牌与歌曲捆绑在一起。这是与俱乐部终生关系的延续，这种关系贯穿了他在农瓜的童年和迈克尔·埃辛等偶像。故事的这一部分在其他地方也有自己的讲述。在这里，它仅仅表现为一位音乐家在最重要的一天穿着他从小就喜欢的衬衫。

news.title: Melvine Malard on giving a lot for a good point
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 为取得好成绩付出了很多
news.body_en: Melvine Malard felt the point Chelsea earned at the end of an intense European encounter against her former club Lyon was a deserved one. Off the back of a rapid turnaround from Sunday’s demanding clash with Arsenal, the Blues were forced to dig deep during an entertaining draw with the most successful club in Women's Champions League history. Malard, who was tasked with leading the attack against familiar faces, highlighted the competitive nature of the contest and the character shown by the squad. ‘There was some good play,’ said Malard. ‘It was a good battle. That’s why it’s a good result, because there was attacking, there was defending, there were chances. So we keep the point. ‘We played three days ago against Arsenal in a match where we gave a lot. Here as well we gave a lot. In the first half, we could have attacked them a bit more, but especially with LJ’s last shot, we could have scored. But it’s a good result for us.’ Occupying the focal point of the Chelsea attack, the 24-year-old was handed important tactical responsibilities by Sonia Bompastor, who was also coming up against her former side. Malard faced a resolute Lyon defensive line but worked tirelessly for the good of the team, and she explained afterwards what her role in the side was. ‘I have a position where I often have to try to hold the ball as high as possible and help the balance of our midfielders,’ she explained. ‘Lyon have a good defence which is well marshalled, but I think it went well and in terms of intensity, defence, attack, we matched them.’
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德认为切尔西在与前东家里昂的一场激烈的欧洲比赛结束时获得的一分是当之无愧的。在周日与阿森纳的激烈交锋中迅速扭转局面后，蓝军被迫在与女足冠军联赛历史上最成功的俱乐部的一场有趣的平局中深入挖掘。马拉德负责领导对熟悉面孔的进攻，他强调了比赛的竞争性和球队所表现出的性格。 “有一些精彩的比赛，”马拉德说。 ‘这是一场精彩的战斗。这就是为什么这是一个好的结果，因为有进攻，有防守，有机会。所以我们保留这一点。 “三天前，我们在对阵阿森纳的比赛中付出了很多。在这里我们也付出了很多。上半场，我们本可以对他们进行更多攻击，但尤其是LJ的最后一脚射门，我们本来可以得分。但这对我们来说是一个很好的结果。” 这位 24 岁的球员占据了切尔西进攻的焦点，索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 赋予了他重要的战术职责，而索尼娅·邦帕斯托也将对阵她的前东家。马拉德面对着坚决的里昂防线，但为了球队的利益而不知疲倦地工作，她事后解释了自己在球队中的角色。 “在我的位置上，我经常需要尝试尽可能高地控球，帮助我们的中场保持平衡，”她解释道。 “里昂的防守很好，组织得很好，但我认为进展顺利，在强度、防守、进攻方面，我们与他们不相上下。”

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: the quarter-final vote
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极目标：四分之一决赛投票
news.body_en: We have reached the quarter-final stage in our search for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season, with eight superlative strikes competing to make it through to the four semi-final spots. The eight goals to have advanced were scored by five Chelsea legends, with three alone from the imperious Eden Hazard and two stunners from Michael Essien. They cover two decades of Chelsea history and include everything from acrobatic finishes to mazy dribbles and long-range thunderbolts. Each goal will no doubt bring back its own special memories for Blues fans and have a place in the heart of all Chelsea supporters, making the decision that much harder. The quarter-finals begin with Essien facing off against himself, with his rasping 30-yard effort against Arsenal taking on his magnificent left-footed volley versus Barcelona. Hazard’s first quarter-final entry is his famous top-corner equaliser against Tottenham Hotspur, taking on that memorable Ramires chip in the Nou Camp. And the magical Belgian is guaranteed at least one semi-final spot as he goes up against himself in the third tie, with his sublime run and finish at Anfield facing off against his powerful solo run against Arsenal. Rounding off our quarter-finals are two of the most recent entrants to our Goal of the Season catalogue. Last season’s sumptuous overhead strike from Joao Pedro takes on Moises Caicedo’s outrageous effort from the halfway line in 2024. You can watch all the pairings below, relive each special moment and choose your favourite in each quarter-final by voting in our four polls on the Chelsea Official App. These will be tight, so make sure you have your say! Michael Essien vs Arsenal - 2007 Essien’s strike made it out of Group A and it is not difficult to see why. With the Blues behind to Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball off to Michael around 30 yards out and the midfielder let rip with a glorious swerving strike that flew into the top corner. Michael Essien vs Barcelona - 2009 Essien’s second contender for the Ultimate Goal of the Season title also came at Stamford Bridge. This time, in the Champions League, where his incredible left-footed effort crashed in off the underside of the crossbar. The Ghanaian met a looping ball on the volley from outside the box and watched as it flew in off the crossbar to give us the lead against Barcelona. On an unforgettable night at the Nou Camp, Ramires’s strike brought us level in the tie and ahead on away goals, setting us on course to our first Champions League trophy. The Brazilian raced on to Frank Lampard’s exquisitely weighted pass and produced the most audacious of finishes as his first-time chip over Victor Valdes found the back of the net. Eden Hazard vs Tottenham - 2016 A fabulous goal saw Eden Hazard end Spurs’ Premier League title hopes during the famous ‘Battle of the Bridge’ match. Linking up superbly with Diego Costa, Hazard latched onto the return ball and curled a beautiful first-time effort into the top corner to send the Blues faithful into delirium. Eden Hazard vs Liverpool - 2019 Hazard once again did it himself when settling a Carabao Cup tie at Anfield. After receiving the ball in the middle of the park, Eden nutmegged Roberto Firmino before exchanging passes with Cesar Azpilicueta. Hazard then burst into the box, producing a second nutmeg on his run, this time on Alberto Moreno, before firing in an unstoppable finish across goal from a tight angle. A truly wondrous moment from the sensational star. Two of Hazard’s most glorious Chelsea efforts go head to head in this tie, with his strike against Arsenal showing everything Eden had to offer the Blues. Picking up possession inside his own half, the Belgian showed his strength to shrug off Francis Coquelin while retaining his balance to take on the Arsenal backline before calmly beating Petr Cech to register a sensational solo goal. Joao Pedro vs Nottingham Forest - 2026 Joao Pedro made it 20 for the season in his debut campaign with a sensational strike against Nottingham Forest. Controlling Marc Cucurella’s header with his chest, the Brazilian instinctively produced an acrobatic overhead kick that flew into the far corner of the goal. Moises Caicedo vs Bournemouth - 2024 Few players can have got off the mark for us in such stupendous fashion as Moises Caicedo. Collecting a loose clearance just inside our own half, Caicedo smashed an inch-perfect effort over the desperately retreating defender and into the empty net from the halfway line. Cast your vote in the quarter-finals of our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here! Return tomorrow (Friday) to find out the goals that have advanced to the semi-finals - that vote will take place on Saturday, before the grand final on Monday!
news.body_zh: 我们已经进入四分之一决赛，寻找切尔西本赛季的终极进球，八个顶级进球将争夺进入四个半决赛的席位。晋级的八个进球是由五位切尔西传奇人物打进的，其中三个进球来自专横的阿扎尔，另外两个进球来自迈克尔·埃辛。它们涵盖了切尔西二十年的历史，包括从杂技般的射门到迷宫般的运球和远距离闪电般的一切。毫无疑问，每一个进球都会给蓝军球迷带来特殊的回忆，并在所有切尔西球迷的心中占有一席之地，让做出决定变得更加困难。四分之一决赛开始时，埃辛将与自己展开对决，对阵阿森纳时，他以30码的急速射门，对阵巴塞罗那时，埃辛则以华丽的左脚凌空抽射。阿扎尔首次闯入四分之一决赛是在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中，他在上角扳平比分，在诺坎普球场对阵拉米雷斯那记令人难忘的进球。这位神奇的比利时人在第三场比赛中与自己较量时，他在安菲尔德对阵阿森纳的强大个人进攻中表现出色，保证了至少一个半决赛席位。四分之一决赛的最后一位是最近入选我们赛季最佳进球的两名球员。上赛季若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 华丽的头顶射门将与 2024 年莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo) 在中场线的令人震惊的射门一较高下。您可以观看下面的所有配对，重温每个特殊时刻，并通过切尔西官方应用程序上的四项民意调查来选择您最喜欢的四分之一决赛。这些会很紧张，所以请确保你有发言权！迈克尔·埃辛 (Michael Essien) 对阵 阿森纳 (Arsenal) - 2007 年，埃辛 (Essien) 的进球让他们从 A 组中脱颖而出，原因也不难理解。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后阿森纳时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球传给了 30 码外的迈克尔，这名中场球员一脚漂亮的转身射门，飞入球门上角。迈克尔·埃辛 vs 巴塞罗那 - 2009 年，埃辛第二个争夺赛季最佳进球称号的竞争者也出现在斯坦福桥。这一次，在欧冠联赛中，他令人难以置信的左脚射门击中了横梁下方。加纳人在禁区外接住一记弧线球，看着球飞过横梁，帮助我们在对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中取得领先。在诺坎普度过了一个难忘的夜晚，拉米雷斯的进球让我们在平局中扳平比分，并以客场进球数领先，让我们朝着我们的第一座欧冠奖杯迈进。巴西人紧接着弗兰克·兰帕德（Frank Lampard）精妙的传球，并完成了最大胆的射门，他的第一次射门越过维克托·巴尔德斯（Victor Valdes）入网。伊登·阿扎尔 vs 托特纳姆热刺 - 2016 年，在著名的“大桥之战”比赛中，阿扎尔打进了一个精彩的进球，终结了热刺的英超冠军希望。阿扎尔与迭戈·科斯塔完美配合，接住回球，并在第一时间将一脚漂亮的射门打入球门上角，让蓝军球迷陷入疯狂。埃登·阿扎尔 vs 利物浦 - 2019 年，阿扎尔在安菲尔德的卡拉宝杯比赛中再次亲自上阵。在公园中央接球后，伊登对罗伯托·菲尔米诺进行了肉豆蔻攻击，然后与塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔交换了传球。随后阿扎尔冲入禁区，在跑动中打出第二粒肉豆蔻球，这次是对着阿尔贝托·莫雷诺，然后以势不可挡的小角度射门射门。来自这位轰动明星的真正奇妙的时刻。阿扎尔在切尔西最辉煌的两场比赛在这场比赛中展开了对决，他在对阵阿森纳的比赛中的进球展示了伊登为蓝军提供的一切。比利时人在自己半场拿到控球权，展现了自己的力量，摆脱了弗朗西斯·科奎林的防守，同时保持平衡，挑战阿森纳的后防线，然后冷静地击败切赫，打进一粒精彩的个人进球。若昂·佩德罗 vs 诺丁汉森林 - 2026 若昂·佩德罗在他的处子秀中对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛中打进一记精彩的进球，打入赛季第 20 场进球。巴西人用胸部控制着马克·库库雷拉的头球，本能地踢出一脚杂技般的倒勾飞入球门远角。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 vs 伯恩茅斯 - 2024 很少有球员能像莫伊塞斯·凯塞多那样以如此惊人的方式为我们取得进球。 凯塞多在本方半场内接到一次松散的解围，一脚完美的射门越过了拼命撤退的防守队员，从中线射入空门。请在切尔西官方应用程序上为我们本赛季终极进球的四分之一决赛投票！明天（周五）回来看看晋级半决赛的目标 - 投票将于周六、周一总决赛之前进行！

news.title: Internationals: Blues duo feature in Argentina win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：蓝军二人组在阿根廷获胜中发挥作用
news.body_en: Emiliano Martinez and Valentin Barco played in Argentina’s first game since the World Cup final as they thrashed Bolivia 4-0 in a friendly in Cordoba. Martinez played the full 90 minutes and enjoyed a quiet evening in goal. He made one save, with Argentina dominating possession and territory throughout, and finished with the captain's armband. This summer’s runners-up led 2-0 at half-time courtesy of goals from Lautaro Martinez and Nico Paz, and they extended their advantage shortly after the restart through Cristian Romero. Barco was then introduced on 56 minutes, replacing Benfica’s Gianluca Prestianni on the left flank. The 22-year-old, fresh from his full Premier League debut, brought energy and intensity to Argentina’s play, with a fourth goal added from Flaco Lopez late on. Argentina’s second and final friendly of this international window is against Burkina Faso on Saturday evening local time.
news.body_zh: 埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯和瓦伦丁·巴尔科在科尔多瓦举行的一场友谊赛中4-0大胜玻利维亚，这是阿根廷自世界杯决赛以来的第一场比赛。马丁内斯打满了 90 分钟，并在球门内度过了一个安静的夜晚。他做出了一次扑救，让阿根廷队全程掌控控球权和领土，并最终戴上了队长袖标。今年夏天的亚军凭借劳塔罗·马丁内斯和尼科·帕斯的进球在半场以2-0领先，并在比赛重新开始后不久通过克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗扩大了优势。第 56 分钟，巴科上场，取代本菲卡左翼球员吉安卢卡·普雷斯蒂亚尼。这位22岁的球员刚刚完成完整的英超首秀，为阿根廷队的比赛带来了活力和强度，弗拉科·洛佩斯在比赛后期打入了第四个进球。阿根廷本次国际比赛窗口期的第二场也是最后一场友谊赛将于当地时间周六晚上对阵布基纳法索。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor explains McCabe and Girma absences and discusses Lyon return
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了麦凯布和吉尔玛的缺席并讨论了里昂的回归
news.body_en: After coming through a tough match with a 0-0 draw against her former side Lyon, Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor explained why Katie McCabe and Naomi Girma were missing from the side on Wednesday evening. McCabe was praised for her performance against Arsenal on Sunday, but did not appear on the teamsheet for the Women's Champions League match at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais. The team fought hard to earn a 0-0 draw against our French opponents, leaving us with four points from our opening two matches in the UWCL league phase. ‘Katie was sick,’ Bompastor explained. ‘Erin (Cuthbert) and Manaka (Matsukubo) are training fully with the team, and potentially they could be involved in the game at the weekend.’ Girma was also absent from the squad on Wednesday, and Bompastor was able to shed some light on her condition before addressing the problem goalkeeper Hannah Hampton suffered in the final minutes of the match. ‘Naomi got a knock in training,’ she continued. ‘So I think she will be unavailable for maybe a few weeks. ‘I didn't have the opportunity to talk to Hannah. She was able to finish the game. I'll speak to her and see how she is, but hopefully she's good and ready to go again.’ Chelsea defended hard against another top side on Wednesday, keeping our fifth consecutive clean sheet. Despite not coming away with all three points, there were many aspects of the performance that pleased Bompastor. ‘I'm really proud of my team for not conceding here in this stadium against a strong team and a strong attacking line,’ she said. ‘We are also happy about the way we performed with the ball. We were able to exploit different spaces between the lines, but also in the spacing behind. The only thing that was missing was probably the goal. We created enough big chances for us to be able to score tonight. ‘It was a very good game with two top teams. I’m happy it gives a good image of women's football. I’m proud that we could have such a high-level performance after playing Arsenal on Sunday. Both games were very good performances and that gives us confidence.' This is Bompastor’s third season at Chelsea since she left Lyon at the end of the 2023/24 campaign. With the match now over, our head coach was able to explain how she felt about returning to a place that once was home, and discussed how she has developed as a coach since joining the Blues. ‘Tonight was really emotional,’ she said. ‘I spent so much time here at this club, in this stadium, so it felt great being able to see so many people I worked with. ‘Being the Chelsea head coach for Chelsea and coming back to this stadium with my team was a proud moment as well. The experience I got here at Lyon helped me to grow as a manager. I'm much more confident now. I’m different in a good way, I would say. More mature and making better decisions.’
news.body_zh: 在经历了一场与老东家里昂0-0战平的艰难比赛后，切尔西主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了凯蒂·麦凯布和娜奥米·吉尔玛周三晚上缺席比赛的原因。麦凯布因其周日对阵阿森纳的表现而受到赞扬，但她没有出现在里昂奥林匹克公园举行的女子冠军联赛比赛的阵容中。球队奋力拼搏，0-0战平法国对手，在UWCL联赛的前两场比赛中我们积4分。 “凯蒂病了，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “艾琳（库斯伯特）和马纳卡（松久保）正在与球队一起进行全面训练，他们可能会参加周末的比赛。”周三，吉尔玛也缺席了球队，邦帕斯特在解决守门员汉娜·汉普顿在比赛最后几分钟遇到的问题之前，能够了解她的状况。 “娜奥米在训练中受到了打击，”她继续说道。 “所以我认为她可能要缺席几周的时间。 “我没有机会和汉娜交谈。她能够完成比赛。我会和她谈谈，看看她怎么样，但希望她状态良好，准备好再次出发。”周三，切尔西在对阵另一支顶级球队的比赛中顽强防守，连续第五次保持不失球。尽管没有全取三分，但比赛的许多方面都让邦帕斯托感到满意。 “我真的为我的球队感到自豪，因为他们在这个体育场面对一支强大的球队和强大的进攻线时没有失球，”她说。 “我们也对我们的控球方式感到满意。我们能够利用线条之间的不同空间，以及后面的空间。唯一缺少的可能就是进球了。我们创造了足够多的绝佳机会，让我们今晚能够进球。 “这是一场非常精彩的比赛，有两支顶级球队参加。我很高兴它为女足树立了良好的形象。我很自豪我们在周日对阵阿森纳后能够取得如此高水平的表现。两场比赛的表现都非常出色，这给了我们信心。”这是庞帕斯托自 2023/24 赛季末离开里昂以来在切尔西的第三个赛季。比赛结束后，我们的主教练能够解释她回到曾经的家的感受，并讨论了自加入蓝军以来她作为一名教练的发展情况。 “今晚真的很激动，”她说。 “我在这个俱乐部、这个体育场度过了很多时间，所以能够见到这么多和我一起工作的人感觉很棒。 “作为切尔西主教练并与我的球队一起回到这个体育场也是一个值得骄傲的时刻。我在里昂的经历帮助我成长为一名经理。我现在更有信心了。我想说，我在某种程度上与众不同。更加成熟并做出更好的决策。”

news.title: Lucy Bronze: We worked our socks off!
news.title_zh: 露西·青铜：我们竭尽全力！
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze was proud of Chelsea's performance after we fought hard for a 0-0 draw away at Lyon in the Women's Champions League on Wednesday night. The Chelsea vice-captain, who wore the armband in the absence of injured skipper Erin Cuthbert, was awarded the Player of the Match award for another heroic performance in the backline. Bronze won both of her tackles, made three key interceptions and attempted the most passes of any Chelsea player on the evening with 71. The experienced defender explained exactly how tough it was to claim a point from high-level opposition on the night, and was pleased overall with the outcome of the match. 'We dominated possession of the ball, especially in the first half,' Bronze said afterwards. 'We played out their press well, but they had some good counter-attacking moments. 'They were on top at the end of the game, but that's what happens when two top teams play against each other - the momentum swings. 'Both teams had a chance to steal a goal and maybe steal a win, but I feel like a draw at this time of the season for both teams is probably not the worst thing.' The Blues came into the game off the back of an intense week, where we had to fight for a win against a tenacious Austria Vienna side last Wednesday, before claiming another 1-0 victory in a fiercely contested London derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon. With that in mind, Bronze was keen to praise a mammoth effort from her team-mates to come through this period unbeaten and with no goals conceded. 'It shows what a tough battle it was today if a defender's getting it!' she said after being told she had been selected as the official Player of the Match. 'As a team, we worked our socks off. 'I'm proud of every single one of us, especially considering we played a really tough game three days ago. We then had to fly to Lyon after that, so to put in a shift like today, I'm really happy with what we've done.'
news.body_zh: 周三晚上，我们在女子冠军联赛中苦苦挣扎，客场0-0战平里昂，露西·布朗兹对切尔西的表现感到自豪。这位在队长艾琳·库斯伯特受伤缺席的情况下佩戴队长袖标的切尔西副队长，因在后防线的又一次英勇表现而被授予本场最佳球员奖。布朗兹赢得了两次铲断，完成了 3 次关键拦截，并以 71 次尝试传球，成为当晚所有切尔西球员中最多的。这位经验丰富的后卫准确地解释了当晚从高水平对手手中夺取一分是多么困难，并对比赛的整体结果感到满意。 “我们控制了球权，尤其是在上半场，”布朗赛后说道。 “我们很好地应对了他们的紧逼，但他们也有一些不错的反击时刻。 “他们在比赛结束时处于领先地位，但这就是当两支顶级球队相互对抗时会发生的情况——势头波动。 “两支球队都有机会偷进一球，也许还能偷取一场胜利，但我觉得在本赛季的这个时候，对两支球队来说，平局可能并不是最糟糕的事情。”蓝军在经历了紧张的一周后进入了比赛，上周三我们必须为战胜顽强的奥地利维也纳球队而战，然后周日下午在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的激烈伦敦德比中又以 1-0 获胜。考虑到这一点，青铜热衷于赞扬她的队友们在这段时期保持不败且不失球的巨大努力。 “如果防守者能做到这一点，那就表明今天是一场多么艰苦的战斗！”她在被告知自己被选为本场比赛的官方最佳球员后说道。 “作为一个团队，我们竭尽全力。 “我为我们每个人感到骄傲，特别是考虑到我们三天前打了一场非常艰难的比赛。之后我们必须飞往里昂，所以像今天这样轮班，我对我们所做的真的很满意。

news.title: Match report: Lyon 0-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：里昂0-0切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea kept a fifth consecutive clean sheet as we battled to a 0-0 draw in the Women's Champions League against a determined Lyon side. This was always going to be a special evening as two top sides met in the UWCL league phase at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais. Head coach Sonia Bompastor and her assistant Camille Abily returned to Lyon for the first time since they left for Chelsea in 2024. There were also returns to Lyon for Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Ellie Carpenter and Melvine Malard, who all crossed paths during their respective spells with the French side. The clear quality of the two teams cancelled each other out for long periods of the game. There were tough challenges all over the pitch as these elite competitors challenged each other to the very maximum level. In the second half, there was high drama with three VAR decisions and a huge save from Hannah Hampton. Yet this was a fair result and a point very well earned away from home against one of Europe's best teams. Head coach Bompastor made two alterations to her starting line-up following Sunday's win over Arsenal, bringing in Veerle Buurman and Sjoeke Nusken for Katie McCabe and Lauren James. Buurman made herself known within 30 seconds of the kick-off, stopping a Lyon attack with one of her perfectly timed sliding tackles on the right-hand touchline. That was a good marker for how the opening exchanges would unfold, as neither side could find any rhythm, with play stopped often for niggly fouls. The first 15 minutes would see us dominate possession with a 61 per cent share of the ball, but our only real attempt on goal was a speculative hooked effort from Malard which went over the bar. Lyon had their first effort on target soon afterwards when a quick break from Melchie Dumornay saw her play a dangerous through-ball to Salma Paralluello, but Hampton was equal to her attempt. Dumornay's pace was causing problems in the middle, and Lexi Potter was penalised for a foul on the Haitian just outside the penalty area just before the half-hour mark. Selma Bacha took the free-kick, and her curling attempt was thankfully too high to trouble Hampton. Neither side seemed willing to fully commit to attack, as the encounter remaining cagey as the clock ticked towards half-time. The second half began with a determined run down the left from Buurman, and as she strode forward, Lyon's Jule Brand brought her down and received a yellow card for the foul. The resulting free-kick saw Nusken felled in the penalty area, and after a few moments of delay, the Video Assistant Referee recommended that the match official view the incident on the screen. No penalty was awarded, seemingly because of an offside against Bronze, although Tarciane did receive a yellow card for the foul on Nusken. After earning a clean sheet in each of our previous four matches, the Blues were defending resolutely once again. The size of Lyon's pitch seemed to make it hard for us to attack with any real purpose, too. The home side had the ball in the net after 70 minutes through Paralluelo, but the attempt was ruled out for offside. The fortunes seemed to have swung in our favour when Lauren James looked to have been tripped inside the box, and the referee immediately awarded a penalty. Yet on closer inspection, it seemed as though the forward had simply lost her footing and VAR cancelled the decision. Both sides seemed happy to play it safe and share the points in the final ten minutes; however, there were some more big chances before the final whistle. For Chelsea, Alyssa Thompson drove to the byline and pulled the ball back brilliantly for James in the centre of the box, but she could only direct her shot at goalkeeper Mala Grohs. Then, a brilliant crossfield ball from Lily Yohannes met the head of Ada Hegerberg, only for Hampton to pull off a superb flying save to deny the competition's all-time leading goalscorer. The VAR checks meant there were eight minutes of time added on to the 90, and Hampton received medical attention after receiving a whack from Temwa Chawinga. Livia Peng was warming up, but Hampton played on. With just seconds still to play, a shot from second-half substitute Maika Hamano went agonisingly wide of the far post with the goalkeeper beaten. In the end, though, the draw was a fair result for both teams after an elite European encounter. We have taken four points from our opening two matches in the Women's Champions League. Our next UWCL challenge is against Roma at Plough Lane on 28 October. We travel to West Ham United in the Women's Super League on Sunday afternoon, before our players head off to represent their respective national teams during the international break. We return to action with a home game against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October. news.body_zh: 切尔西在女足冠军联赛中以 0-0 战平顽强的里昂队，连续第五次不失球。这总是一个特别的夜晚，因为两支顶级球队在 UWCL 联赛阶段在里昂奥林匹克公园球场相遇。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托和她的助手卡米尔·阿比利自 2024 年前往切尔西以来首次返回里昂。露西·布朗兹、卡德莎·布坎南、艾莉·卡彭特和梅尔文·马拉德也重返里昂，他们都在各自效力法国球队期间有过交集。两队的明显实力在比赛的很长一段时间内相互抵消。球场上充满了严峻的挑战，这些精英选手互相挑战到了最高水平。下半场上演了戏剧性的一幕，三项VAR判罚以及汉娜·汉普顿的一次巨大扑救。然而，这是一个公平的结果，并且在客场​​对阵欧洲最好的球队之一时赢得了很好的一分。在周日战胜阿森纳后，主教练邦帕斯特对首发阵容进行了两次调整，用维尔勒·布尔曼和索克·努斯肯换下凯蒂·麦凯布和劳伦·詹姆斯。布尔曼在开球后 30 秒内就展现出了自己的实力，她在右侧边线精准地铲断了一次里昂的进攻，阻止了里昂的进攻。这是开场比赛如何展开的一个很好的标志，因为双方都找不到任何节奏，比赛经常因为犯规而停止。前 15 分钟，我们以 61% 的控球率占据了控球权，但我们唯一真正的射门尝试是马拉德的一次投机性勾射，球高出了横梁。不久之后，里昂首次射门，梅尔奇·杜莫内快速突破，将球传给萨尔玛·帕拉卢埃洛，但汉普顿追平了她的射门。杜莫内的速度在中场造成了问题，莱克西·波特在半小时前禁区外对海地人犯规而受到处罚。塞尔玛·巴查主罚任意球，幸好她的弧线球射得太高，没有给汉普顿带来麻烦。双方似乎都不愿意全力进攻，随着半场时间的流逝，这场比赛仍然保持谨慎。下半场开始，布尔曼左路坚决跑动，当她大步向前时，里昂队的朱尔·布兰德将她放倒，并因犯规而吃到黄牌。努斯肯开出的任意球倒在禁区内，在短暂的延迟后，视频助理裁判建议比赛官员在屏幕上查看这一事件。尽管塔尔西安确实因对努斯肯犯规而吃到黄牌，但似乎是因为对布伦兹的越位而没有判罚点球。在之前四场比赛均保持不失球后，蓝军再次坚决防守。里昂球场的规模似乎也让我们很难进行真正有目的的进攻。第70分钟，主队通过帕拉卢埃洛将球射入网内，但由于越位在先被判无效。当劳伦·詹姆斯看起来被禁区内绊倒时，命运似乎对我们有利，裁判立即判罚了点球。然而仔细观察后发现，这位前锋似乎只是失去了立足点，VAR 取消了这一决定。双方似乎都很乐意谨慎行事，并在最后十分钟分享得分；然而，在终场哨声响起之前，还有一些更大的机会。切尔西方面，阿丽莎·汤普森带球到底线，在禁区中央为詹姆斯漂亮地回球，但她只能将射门对准门将马拉·格罗斯。随后，莉莉·约翰内斯 (Lily Yohannes) 的一脚漂亮的横传球碰到了阿达·赫格伯格 (Ada Hegerberg) 的头球，汉普顿 (Hampton) 完成了一次精彩的飞身扑救，将这位比赛历史上的最佳射手挡出。 VAR检查意味着90分钟的时间增加了8分钟，汉普顿在受到特姆瓦·查温加(Temwa Chawinga)的重击后接受了医疗护理。彭莉薇 (Livia Peng) 正在热身，但汉普顿 (Hampton) 仍在继续比赛。比赛还剩几秒时，下半场替补出场的滨野麻香的射门不幸偏出远门柱，门将被击中。不过，最终，在一场欧洲精英赛之后，平局对两支球队来说都是一个公平的结果。我们在女足冠军联赛的前两场比赛中拿到了四分。 我们的下一场 UWCL 挑战将于 10 月 28 日在 Plough Lane 对阵罗马。周日下午，我们将前往参加女子超级联赛的西汉姆联队，然后我们的球员将在国际比赛日期间代表各自的国家队出发。 10 月 18 日，我们将在斯坦福桥主场迎战托特纳姆热刺队。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、布尔曼、沃尔什、波特、卡普坦、努斯肯、汤普森、马拉德（詹姆斯 58）未上场替补：彭、斯宾塞、佩尔茨、比约恩、拉斯、德拉戈尼、布朗、哈马诺、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯 黄牌：波特 27 里昂：格罗斯、恩根、塔西亚尼（雷纳德） 76), Bacha (c), Brand, Egurrola, Yohannes, Paralluelo (Chawinga 76), Weir (Becho 76), Katoto (Hegerberg 64), Dumornay未上场替补: Endler, Belhadj, Shrader, Benyahia, Lawrence, Swierot, Sangare, Joseph预订: Brand 50, Tarciane 54裁判: Marta Huerta德阿扎
